label: Nodes of an expression tree
subgoals: Make each operator an internal node with its operands as children
Count every operand occurrence as a leaf
Drop parentheses because the shape already records them

label: Height and traversal
subgoals: Identify the root as the operator applied last
Measure height as edges on the longest root-to-leaf path
Evaluate in post-order and push context down in pre-order

label: Sharing subtrees in a DAG
subgoals: Hash each node by its operator and its children's identities
Reuse an existing node when the hash matches
Count the distinct nodes that remain in the DAG
